papers.title: Hierarchical Clustering Can Jointly Satisfy Richness, Consistency, and Scale Invariance
papers.authors: Daichi Kuroda, Maximilien Dreveton, Matthias Grossglauser, Patrick Thiran
papers.label: Preprint
papers.summary: Shows that hierarchical analogues of richness, consistency, and scale invariance can hold jointly, and characterizes the resulting methods.

papers.title: When Does Bottom-Up Beat Top-Down in Hierarchical Community Detection?
papers.authors: Maximilien Dreveton, Daichi Kuroda, Matthias Grossglauser, Patrick Thiran
papers.label: JASA
papers.summary: Establishes recovery guarantees for bottom-up hierarchical community detection, including optimal exact recovery thresholds at intermediate levels of the hierarchy.

papers.title: Hierarchical Linkage Clustering Beyond Binary Trees and Ultrametrics
papers.authors: Maximilien Dreveton, Matthias Grossglauser, Daichi Kuroda, Patrick Thiran
papers.label: Preprint
papers.summary: Introduces valid hierarchies and a linkage followed by pruning procedure that recovers the finest valid hierarchy under precise conditions.
